oneInvocationBoundary.singleMetric: New standalone RPC and HTTP wrappers invoke business work once and emit one service_operation per invocation.

oneInvocationBoundary.supplementalAggregates: Auth review health has four queue-state aggregates; allocation source health has five. Drain adds one finite per configured club fairness observation alongside its invocation record.
oneInvocationBoundary.operatorExistingEmitter: Uses the pre-existing route classification and generated response correlation; private mode suppresses legacy emission. No default console or missing-retention fallback.

limitations: Local WorkerEntrypoint test loader runs actual entrypoint JavaScript with real SQLite fixtures; it does not emulate hosted RPC, workerd or D1.
The distributed disabled templates have no private telemetry binding or retention value; restrictive deployment guards remain unchanged and reject unapproved capabilities.
Retention, sink binding exclusivity, hosted ACL/storage/provider/device behavior and production SLO acceptance require separately approved configuration and evidence.
Only finite aggregate club scalars, generated traces, timestamps, bounded duration and finite outcomes enter metrics; no metric receipt establishes provider, financial or business acceptance.
The current-source test counts overlap earlier delivery and operator banks; they must not be added as unique assertions. No external network call, deploy, commit or push was performed.
